A letter I probably wouldn't be able to say properly in person…

Dear Bestessstttt ,


I don't know when exactly you became such an important & precious part of my life.


Maybe it happened through all those random conversations. Maybe through the laughter. Maybe through the difficult days. Maybe through all those tiny moments that didn't seem important at the time… but somehow became memories I'll always keep.


You've seen different versions of me...hehe the happy one, the stupid one, the stressed one, the confused one, the version that talks too much, and probably the version that annoys you the most. 😂


And somehow, you stayed. That's something I will always be grateful for💖


Rekha, I hope life gives you the kind of happiness you don't have to force. The kind of people who choose you genuinely. The kind of dreams that make you excited to wake up. And the kind of moments that make you stop and think: "Wow… life is actually beautiful."


And whenever life becomes difficult, I hope you remember that there is someone somewhere who genuinely wants to see you happy. Always.


Happiestt 25th Birthdaaaayyyy, Rekhaaa. 🎂💖


Keep smiling. Keep being the crazy, beautiful, wonderful person you are. And please… don't ever become boring. 😂 Because the world needs your madness. And honestly, my life wouldn't be the same without it.

— Nilesh Jha❤️
